title: GEMglBindProgramARB
description: bind an ARB vertex or fragment program

messages.description: ID of the program to bind

arguments.description: ID of the program to bind

body: [GEMglBindProgramARB] calls glBindProgramARB() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. GL constants are numbers here: [GLdefine] turns a name like GL_LINES into its value.
